summary: fix(email-sender): adapt to nodemailer 10 bundled types
description:
Because:

- nodemailer 10 ships its own TypeScript types, which type SentMessageInfo.message as unknown and declare the callback overload of sendMail last.

This commit:

- Copies info.message into the send result only when it is a string.
- Types the spec's transporter mock with the promise form of sendMail.
- Adds the now-required envelope to the spec's mock send results.
